primaryChecks.text: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
contextRefs: JOS 19:11 — Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
JOS 19:13 — From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

primaryChecks.text: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
contextRefs: JOS 21:27 — They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
JOS 21:29 — Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
